title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(木虎久隆研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III(Kitora Hisataka)
educationalGoal: We have entered an era in which buildings and homes must be ZEB compliant. To achieve this, energy-saving performance must be demonstrated during operation, and for this purpose, verification (commissioning) of building equipment and energy systems must be conducted at each stage from design to operation. In addition, in the era of mass introduction of renewable energy, energy flexibility that integrates buildings with the electric power system is required. We will conduct research on building facilities to realize a carbon-neutral society.
advice: The main area of instruction is building equipment for a carbon neutral society, and research is conducted using actual measurements and simulations to reduce greenhouse gas emissions in the building sector, focusing on energy conservation, but also including issues related to the built environment, such as the relationship between people and buildings, including indoor comfort and productivity improvement. This area also includes issues in the field of architectural environmental engineering, such as the relationship between people and buildings in terms of indoor comfort and productivity improvement, etc.

requiredKnowledge: It is desirable to study the basic subjects of planning, structure, and environment of architecture. It is desirable to have knowledge of data processing, and to be willing to work on it. It is important to have a high awareness of social environmental issues and to be able to take action.

achievementLevels.ideal: Students must be actively and continuously engaged in seminar activities throughout the year, and must be able to submit a project report summarizing the results that meet the objectives of the seminar. The student must also be judged excellent in terms of expression and communication skills at the interim presentation and at the public presentation review meeting. Ideally, the project results should be at a level to be presented at the Architectural Institute of Japan and other academic societies.
achievementLevels.standard: Students must be able to work continuously on seminar activities throughout the year and submit a project report summarizing the results that meet the objectives of the seminar. The student must also be judged to be in good standing in terms of expression and communication skills at the interim presentation and at the public presentation review meeting.
